intent: A sober enterprise visual system that improves hierarchy, orientation and continuity without changing authority, meaning or claim boundaries.
claimBoundary: The design-system evidence demonstrates implemented presentation and interaction safeguards in the candidate UI. It does not establish accessibility conformance, legal compliance, production readiness or user-research validity.
invariants: visual styling never changes server-issued authority
one primary action per decision context
focus is visible and never replaced by hover
interactive targets remain at least 44 CSS pixels where operationally required
surface transitions never move focus or block input
forced colours retain labels, borders and focus
dark and light modes preserve information hierarchy
mobile navigation may scroll internally but the document does not overflow horizontally
disclosure state remains native and keyboard-operable
dialogs retain explicit close and action semantics
elevation communicates layering but not evidentiary certainty
status colour is redundant to visible text
gradients are decorative and removable without information loss
design-system installation is terminal and reversible

visualReview.asIs: Flat chrome, weak separation and undifferentiated cards.
visualReview.fix: Sticky translucent chrome, process accents, stronger hierarchy and restrained elevation.

visualReview.asIs: Actions and records read as raw browser controls.
visualReview.fix: Explicit action priority, state badges, elevated record cards and accent continuity.

visualReview.asIs: Record state and next action have limited visual hierarchy.
visualReview.fix: Attention tone, consistent card anatomy and surface-specific amber accent.

visualReview.asIs: Metrics and technical disclosure compete with the page title.
visualReview.fix: Summary-first proof panel, metric grid and violet technical accent.

visualReview.asIs: Dialog and navigation lack depth and active-section continuity.
visualReview.fix: Raised control centre, selected section rail and one-panel composition.

visualReview.asIs: All modal layers share the same flat plane.
visualReview.fix: Backdrop, raised shell, stable header/footer and bounded entrance transition.

visualReview.asIs: Chrome and proof metrics compress without clear grouping.
visualReview.fix: Wrapped account controls, internal navigation scroll and two-column metric grouping.
Semantic dark tokens with equivalent hierarchy and status text.
